title: Directional extension × strong H1 rejection — executable reversal

dataset.analysis_timeframe: NY17 Daily extension / H1 rejection / M1 BID-ASK execution
dataset.price_basis: midpoint structural H1 signal with executable BID/ASK response

windows.protected_holdout: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened

hypotheses.market_question: Does a generic strong H1 rejection become more reversal-prone as pre-rejection directional extension from the NY17 day open increases, and does S2/R2 add reversal information after extension is controlled?
hypotheses.null: Greater extension does not create stable positive executable 4H countertrend expectancy, and S2/R2 does not add positive matched reversal expectancy beyond generic strong rejection at comparable extension.
hypotheses.alternative: Greater extension creates a stable positive executable 4H countertrend edge under the frozen gate, with S2/R2 tested only as an incremental matched explanatory layer.
hypotheses.mechanism: If directional travel exhausts the incoming move, a strong H1 rejection after unusually large lagged-Daily-ATR extension should have increasingly favorable countertrend response.

method.primary_endpoint: REV4_ATR executable four-hour countertrend return normalized by lagged H1 ATR24
method.event_definition: generic directional H1 strong rejection wick >=30%, above/below NY17 day open in incoming direction, dual-strong bars excluded
method.extension: distance from NY17 FX-day open to rejection extreme divided by lagged 20-day NY17 Daily ATR
method.execution: first active M1 after H1 close; long ASK/BID exit, short BID/ASK exit; fixed 240-minute primary horizon; no unsafe gap bridging
controls: extension-matched NON_CORE strong rejection for pivot increments
method.pivot_increment: S2/R2-core and S1/R1-core versus NON_CORE within pair-year-direction and frozen 0.25-Daily-ATR extension strata using min(n_pivot,n_control) weights
method.overlap_rule: primary preserves all eligible signals; 4H same-pair/same-reversal-direction cooldown is robustness only

inference.slope: event-level OLS with intercept via cluster sufficient statistics

promotion_gate: continuous extension slope >0 with 95% CI lower bound >0
E3 minus E0 >0 with 95% CI lower bound >0
E3 mean executable REV4_ATR >0 with 95% CI lower bound >0
E3 minus E0 positive in development and validation
at least 7/10 pair-level E3 minus E0 contrasts positive
4H cooldown preserves positive slope, positive E3 mean and positive E3-minus-E0

holdout.protected_window: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened
holdout.prior_exposure: 2015-2025 had prior exposure in related pivot research, but this generic extension architecture and bins were prospectively frozen before outcome calculation. 2026 remained untouched.

provenance.notes: S2/R2 is evaluated only after direct extension control; 2026 exposure conditional on the full frozen primary extension gate.
